title: timeline mp4 export video only v1

commit.merge_subject: merge: timeline mp4 export video only v1

description:
The timeline's export is reachable: the timeline screen's top bar
gains an Export action that queues the timeline's video track as an
MP4 through the same serial ExportQueue every other export uses.

- TimelineScreen: onExportTimeline hands up the COMMITTED project
  (the same project save would persist — never a drag preview),
  because the export snapshot must freeze user intent at queue time
  (ExportJob.timeline): a later edit, split or delete must not
  change an in-flight export. The action uses the editor's Export
  glyph (Icons.AutoMirrored.Filled.ExitToApp — the house icon
  language, no new drawable).
- AppNav: constructs the real TimelineMp4Exporter on the queue with
  live-world seams — sources from the Library store (read at run
  time, not the UI's snapshot state), fpsMeasured and frameCount
